title: Nothing Spectacular
text: Nothing Spectacular. Just a simple rubber dish drainer. The only thing exceptional is the ability to roll it up and close it. Who does that anyway?

product_metadata.title: Vimeka Silicone Goblet Drying Pad with High Ridges for Better Aeration, Counter Mat for Hot Pots and Pans, Dish Wash Safe, BPA Free …
features: PERFECT SIZE: This dish drying mat measures 18" x 8" x 0.3", which can dry most pots, pans, bowls, dishes, glassware and utensils, reasonable and big enough, perfect for family use, fitting most drying rack and countertop

SAFE MATERIAL: Vimeka dish rack mat is made of 100% food-grade silicone, BPA free, safe for family use, super soft and flexible without scratches, perfect counter protector for kitchen, glasses and mugs is not easty to slid off the mat

DRY DISHES FASTER: The dish drainer mat is designed with raised line ridges for maximizing air-flow, keeping a great aeration for dishes, water drains quickly and dry faster, your countertop always keep dry and clean

MULTI PURPOSE: Unlike most dish racks or regular hand towels, this drying mat bears a high temperatures up to 450 degrees F, perfect for a heat resistant trivet under a hot pan or baking dish that just came out of the oven, used as a pet mat under your cat or dog’s water

EASY CLEAN & STORE: Wide grooves make it super easy to clean, just simply wipe off spills and water to clean, it can be also easily cleaned with warm water or in a dishwasher, rolled up or folded for easy storage when not in use, perfect for kitchen drawers, small cabinets, campers, boats and RVs
